reviews.text: The vet was so professional, experienced and genuinely caring towards my pet. She gave her a really thorough check-up and took the time to make sure everything was okay. I was very pleased with the appointment and would definitely recommend her.
Great help. Very welcoming, extremely professional
Very friendly and professional service. The pet plan is very reasonable. I like the vets and so do my pets.
Lovely vets and great service. Thank you!
The staff is very friendly.

A big thank you to all the team at Medivet kentish town for the treatment and care given to my dog in the past and present most recently getting Roxy spayed after a really horrible whome infection couldn't be more happy with the results and after care,and at a resonable cost two.Thanks Medivets for all the great work you all do.Roxy Saunders and Mr J Saunders
Fantastic service always. Kevin and the team are wonderful - it's a pleasure to go visit them with my rescue sidekick Carlton!
Our cats are always treated with genuine care at this practice. The staff are also polite and respectful
Good and thorough care for our pets
My cat(s) have been cared for by the team at Medivet Kentish Town for many years and I have always found the care to be everything I could wish for.

Very professional and experienced staff
Fantastic service.
Thank you

Kentish Town branch has been there for me over many years and many animals.  Always find them sympathetic and helpful with advice for Simba the elderly lab - at 13 he's on borrowed time but
hopefully will keep going for a while yet!!

The staff are always really friendly, sympathetic and supportive. They care deeply for the animals they look after and always look for cost options rather than pressuring me into expensive treatments that are not necessary. Highly recommended!
They’re so knowledgeable and friendly. Really made it a good experience for me and my cat.
They are professional and had no trouble in giving my cat a health check even though she is a temperamental cat and doesn't like being handled.

Our first visit with our new puppy.A different experience under Covid restrictions but the vet was very helpful and explained every process to us and discussed the best options of the pet plan for our pup, very friendly and helpful. I had a phone call an hour before to check that our pup was well and that we were aware of the restrictions. The receptionist was also very helpful and polite and my puppy seem to be ok with the visit. A good online and face to face experience. All members of staff were professional and experienced and provided some good advice, especially for teething puppies.
Friendly and helpful practice
It's very expensive.
Very efficient. My cat didnt get chance to be worried.
Lovely caring vet in Hampstead Villige Medivet!
Great Vet Kevin who all the cats Love !
Really pleased to say the service was exceptional. Got an appointment fast and didn’t have to wait to see the vet. All sorted and cat getting better
Great service, prompt, lovely vet and did not charge unnecessarily which is a huge bonus!!
Amazing vets practice Medivet Receptionist very very  professional and the vet one of the finest too. Great service.
Very happy with the service thank you
Lovely care and friendly staff made me and kitty feel reassured 😊 …

Kentish Town. Wonderful vets. Friendly team. But soooo expensive. I think they are all expensive but seriously £860 for dental treatment for my cat. She needed it, so it’s really great she is not in pain any more but what do people in lower incomes do?!

I had the worst experience at Medivet Kentish Town and I feel strongly that other pet owners should be aware.

The service was completely unprofessional. There was a clear lack of care and concern for my pets, especially when I was genuinely worried about their health. Instead of feeling supported, I felt dismissed and disregarded.

What upset me most was how the staff appeared to cover for one another rather than address the poor service. No one took accountability, and no one stood up for basic customer care. My concerns about my pet’s condition were not taken seriously, they were more concerned about a missed appointment due to illness, and they dismissed my feelings and instead were rude that is unacceptable in a veterinary setting where trust and compassion are essential.

As a pet owner, you expect empathy, transparency, and professionalism. Sadly, I experienced none of that here. Because of this, I have moved all my pets elsewhere.

I would not recommend this practice to anyone who wants their pets treated with genuine care and respect.

They couldn’t even see my cat who was severely constipated and straining. I would suggest an urgent case. I phoned at 9.10am on a Friday and they could offer me no appointments on that day or the following day.
Since Murdo was complimented by the vet for his good looks yesterday when I took him to receive his booster jab, how can I not share my 5 star review?

Was worried about some negative reviews but recently had a great experience taking our newly adopted (quite difficult to handle!) cat here for the first time. Super friendly and helpful staff and we were incredibly impressed with how the vet handled our cat and the treatment received- overall couldn't have gone smoother and very happy with the level of care and cost.
I really like the people at this clinic. Everyone is very kind, helpful and caring. The clinic is small but clean. Making appointments is very easy and can be done online.
Everyone at the practice was extremely helpful, and the vet was wonderfully caring and professional. They took great care of my cat and made sure every need was fully addressed.
The vet and staff at medivet are extremely helpful and care for your pets needs five star 🤩 …

I was told by this practice that my cat urgently needed to go to the emergency room due to a blocked bladder. They said I’d receive a quote for the procedure after he was already in the operating room, and didn’t even offer a rough estimate beforehand despite this being a very common condition in male cats. With their supposed experience and “structured pricing,” they could have easily provided a ballpark figure.

When they finally came back, the quote was nearly £3,000,
absolutely unbelievable. To make matters worse, my cat experienced the same issue just a week later, which makes me seriously doubt they resolved the problem properly the first time. The second procedure, done elsewhere, cost me less than one-sixth of what Medivet quoted.

Thanks, Medivet!
If you care for your pet, avoid this clinic
Medivet Kentish Town is a very caring practice. Ahmed the vet nurse was so gentle and caring when giving my cat his worming treatment last week.

Recently had to put our 16 year old cat to sleep, the help and compassion shown by the staff from lending us a cat carrier as our cat was usually so healthy we didn't have one to the explanation of issues the cat had were informative and compassionate. The after offer of fur clippings and paw prints to be with the ashes was fantastic. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend this branch 👍🏻
Always friendly to help ❤️

Really losing confidence in this practice.
Again bad administration, when receptions checked dogs previous fleas treatment , was surprised when she said
Last medication is 2023 which is shocking because Oliver had flea treatment during the heat waves this summer

Seems to be an issue with the administration when I’m registered last year they never updated the record from the previous vet,
So today was concerning that this is still an issue.
I am not sure if it’s because of laziness or lack of experience. Or just incompetence.
Was given incorrect treatment yesterday and it happened again today. Twice! My time wasted, frustrating and poor customer service.
The flea treatment prescribed was tablets form, my dog had IBD do prefer to not risk a reaction.
Next day a different spot on 1 pipet 3 months)48 £ was expensive and again had concerns of reaction, then told last time Oliver had  treatment was in 2023 , when i had meds recently.
I am losing confidence and seems to be lack of record keeping.
Dillon and dog Oliver,
(New complaint
!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
Incredible
Again received a text to pick up medication for Oliver and arthritis, usual medication no change.
Monthly
gabapentin(arthritis meds for dogs and humans apparently.
As didn’t have in stock only gave me 7, put on order for remaining months  supply.
Given wrong dosage
Said on bottle was 100 mg
Took home realised as usual capsule, split into twice a day.
But realised tiny tablets ( impossible to divide in to two .
When i call reception, who spoke to vet.
Sit was informed that i was given wrong medication ( suprise surprise, not in a cilla black way.
I explained that you give me 30 tablets twice a day at 25 mg ( incorrectly labelled/dangerous
Or you give me 30 capsules easy to split at correct dosage.
So you charge me the same for lowe diasage.
Honestly I have raised another complaint.
Don’t waste my time and money, with my beloved dog.
You need to sort this out.

A very nice locum, but he made a rather cursory examination of my cat and I felt as if he was in a hurry. No bowel check that I could see and no combing for fleas. Only a quick look at her teeth and eyes. And he had to use a pill applicator rather than use the expert method of delivering a pill.
I had a lovely first visit with my new puppy. He was checked thoroughly and the lady veterinarian was very kind and helpful. The two receptionist/assistants were also very friendly and helpful.
Have been taking my various pets to the Prince of Wales Road practice for over 30 years.  The vets are very knowledgeable and always helpful and caring.

Where do we start about this practice... waited weeks to have a short phone call with the vet Tracey with a couple of questions about a procedure to be done on my pet, which im actually still waiting (not really anymore haha) contacting the practice every single day and being told she would phone me that day, she called on a Wednesday at 8pm and the call didnt conect tried to call back straightaway and obviously did not connect as the place was closed, then she was off until the following week!

I was also charged incorrectly as my consult and treatments in a previous appointment were included in my plan. Im still waiting for some of that money to be refunded to me after months...

So overall i would say please AVOID this practice like a plague, you can see in many of the reviews we are all stating similar situations with the same vet, save yourself the headache!

Great team and always great advice.
Being going here for years 🐶 …
Very friendly, attentive and give me good advise
We love the staff at Medivet Kentish Town. Always helpful,  knowledgeable and caring - and we've known vet Tracey for years! And special mention for Ahmed on reception, always so friendly.

Very disappointed with Medivet Kentish Town. We told them months in advance that we were relocating abroad and needed our cat, Milo, travel-ready. Despite several visits, vet Tracy failed to ensure he had the required rabies vaccine—and only told us days before our move.

This avoidable mistake caused major stress, extra costs, and left us separated from our pet. We trusted their advice and were badly let down. Would not recommend for travel-related care.

the best vets who saved my dogs life! cant thank them enough.
dxx
I am more than happy to take my cat, Milo, to Medivet at Kentish Town

I am absolutely appalled to see the attitude of some of this practices vet staff mainly Tracey. Very dismissive, rude and impolite to client and even their own staff! Although, the receptionists are extremely kind and helpful the vet staff are really letting the medivet brand down! Reading other reviews has shown me I’m not the only one feeling this way!
great service, very pleasant and stress free experience for my cat Tilly
Brilliant visit, made my dog Cody feel very comfortable.

So glad I took the initiative to change from a well known practice. Medivet to me seem all about the animal and reassure and GENTLY!!!advise. I have come away not so worried as previously I have been. So glad I changed vets.

We attended for a free 6month puppy health check it lasted all of 5mins, I asked for flea and worm treatment and headed out to pay. To my horror I was told that my bill was £120, explaining that it’s a free check and that the tablets should have be cheaper as have purchased them before……out comes Tracy(sorry if that wasn’t her name) telling me “it can’t be, I don’t think so” in an aggressive way when I told her I paid a different price…..she embarrassed and belittled me in front of other customers. So having checked my dogs file it was noted that my previous purchase was cheaper, I will NOT be returning to them as her customer service skills are very poor and has certainly put me off returning. I will be seeking an alternative vet for my pet. The staff that were at reception were absolutely fantastic, it’s them and the pets I feel sorry for………
Very welcoming, very clean, very polite front desk staff. Will definitely be going back there.

Very friendly reception staff. They acknowledged us and our cat who was meowing loudly.
The vet was friendly, informative and gave us lots of information on how to help our pet.
Not at all a professional vets, Baseelah is the only staff member here that is worth coming for and would recommend her 10/10.
Happy with the vet. They understand my pet well.
From the receptionist to the Vet a truly wonderful practise. Thank you
Very caring staff with elderly dog  needing urgent medication.

A little bit pricey BUT the best vet practice I've ever visited
Very caring staff/ 5 star to them

My mum had the pleasure of meeting the receptionist baseelah she was absolutely amazing and kind, she gave so much information and was just very kind to her 🥰 will definitely be continuing our services here …
Gizmo and I experience at MediVet was great. Gizmo was seen to early as we arrived at appointment early. Vet was informative has I'm a first time owner 😊👍 …

Dr Tracy is brilliant with looking after my senior cat and I am confident that she will have a couple of more happy years to grow older. Great team, including support for insurance claims, reception team always have a big smile. Thank you all. I highly recommend them.

Phoned up last Friday with my cat needing flea treatment there said it needed to be dispensed by the vet have to wait Phoned again on the mon _Tuesday still hadn't been done staff shortage  then Phoned on the Thursday and they said i had to bring my cat in before they would dispense it but I could have a different brand the next day all the time my cat suffering see what tomorrow brings if anything

When I visited yesterday the receptionist was very helpful. I had just had a consultation with my cat and there was an elderly customer buying food and they had a number of queries. The receptionist was very helpful and answered her questions clearly. Then she helped me afterwards. Really nice to see.

Really excellent, friendly, trustworthy practice. They've provided great care for our dog, charge reasonable prices and won't recommend unnecessary treatments or products. 5/5

would give them zero stars if I could. My dog had a seizure and I phoned up in a panic asking if they could see him in emergency and they refused saying that they had no availability. A Caring vet would’ve made time

I found Medivets very efficient.  And the vet, Dr Tashy Milevoj was very caring and through in her tests of my old cat, Macho.

Absolutely awful!!!

You book said appointment and still, no mention of the cost, you attend the appointment and are only informed at the end of the “consultation” that they will be charging you £66 for this!
£66 for what I don’t know! Absolute rip off, for reference, I was also charged over £230 to spay and microchip my cat.
